definitions.gloss: clearance item; markdown item; discount merchandise
definitions.explanation: Products sold at reduced prices because they are nearing expiration, slightly damaged, or the store wants to clear inventory.

examples.japanese: {見切|みき}り{品|ひん}コーナーで{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought it from the clearance section.

examples.japanese: この{野菜|やさい}は{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}で{半額|はんがく}だった。
examples.english: These vegetables were half price as clearance items.

examples.japanese: {閉店前|へいてんまえ}に{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}を{狙|ねら}って{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: I go shopping before closing time to get clearance items.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{見切|みき}り (giving up on, writing off) + {品|ひん} (item) - items the store has given up on selling at full price.

USAGE:
Common at:
・Supermarkets (near-expiry food)
・Department stores (seasonal items)
・Electronics stores (older models)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}コーナー - clearance section
・{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}セール - clearance sale

RELATED TERMS:
・{値引|ねび}き{品|ひん} - discounted items
・{処分品|しょぶんひん} - items for disposal/clearance
